status: PROVED PARTIAL / FINITE-STATE POLYNOMIAL-DEGREE AMPLIFICATION / AUDIT-PENDING
old_claim: For fixed finite-state row-centered vertex-exchangeable graphons, source-scale bounded LDA forces local cycle criticality; an additional global overlap-entropy condition yields all-test post-noise contiguity, while Potts gives an all-test obstruction when that condition fails.
new_claim: Without the global overlap-entropy condition, source-scale bounded LDA plus any fixed positive product noise implies bounded noisy LDA through every degree L_n with L_n^10/n -> 0. In particular degree n^delta is protected for every fixed delta<1/10.
new_lemma: For a connected non-cycle motif with minimum degree at least two and excess r=e-v, |t(F,W)| <= Lambda^e mu_*^{-3r}. Suppressing degree-two chains leaves at most 2r branch vertices and 3r branch edges.
exact_gap: The theorem is restricted to fixed finite-state iid-vertex latent graphons with conditionally independent edges. The 1/10 exponent is crude and Mao's Reed-Muller/rank construction lies outside this class.
next_attack: Sharpen excess enumeration/contraction to enlarge the protected degree exponent; then extend from finite-state to compact or infinite-rank graphons under spectral-decay/Schatten hypotheses, and identify the corresponding diagram obstruction in Mao.
source_boundary: Kireeva Randomstrasse101 2026-06-05 Open Problem 35; Mao arXiv:2607.20318 submitted 2026-07-22 remains a counterexample to the unrestricted polynomial-time low-degree conjecture.
delivery: GitHub-only; no email, Drive, public posting, permission changes, force-push, or peer overwrite.
